page.overview:
Who is Marith Jaen?

Marith Jaen was Amyrlin Seat from to . She was raised from the Blue Ajah.

Born in , she went to the White Tower in . She is described in the Companion as being a "stainless-steel bitch".

She retired to the country in when Tamra Ospenya was raised Amyrlin Seat. It was speculated that she did so because of personality clashes with Tamra, and because she wanted to be Amyrlin instead. Her stated reason was that she wished to write her memoirs.

After the death of Sierin Vayu in , Marith was called from retirement to take the Amyrlin Seat. The Hall felt they had no choice, as both Tamra and Sierin had died suddenly, as had many senior sisters (as part of the Black Ajah's efforts to find the Dragon Reborn for themselves).
